column1: H2-ORR1H2-CRD1The Observable Representation shall preserve whether the current operational situation requires an avoidance maneuver to prevent collision.AvoidanceRequired_R(x) != AvoidanceRequired_R(y) for situations separated by H2-CRD1.SG-2;H-2;FR-8Without this distinction the representation cannot support the judgement of whether the avoidance maneuver is required.

H2-ORR2H2-CRD2The Observable Representation shall preserve whether a required lane-change avoidance maneuver is safely feasible under the applicable road/lane geometry and adjacent-lane traffic conditions.SafeFeasible_R(x) != SafeFeasible_R(y) for situations separated by H2-CRD2.FR-8;FR-8.1;FR-8.2The representation may abstract individual geometry and traffic variables provided that it preserves the safe-feasibility distinction required by the evaluative intent.

H2-ORR3H2-CRD3The Observable Representation shall preserve whether initiation of the required lane-change maneuver satisfies the applicable 100 ms temporal bound.[t_init_R(x) <= 100 ms] != [t_init_R(y) <= 100 ms].FR-8.3The documented timing requirement distinguishes timely from late maneuver initiation; the 100 ms bound is marked tbc and the dangerous-zone condition tbd in the source.

H2-ORR4H2-CRD4The Observable Representation shall preserve whether steering commands required for the avoidance maneuver are provided within the applicable 50 ms temporal bound.[t_steer_R(x) <= 50 ms] != [t_steer_R(y) <= 50 ms].FR-8.4The documented timing requirement distinguishes timely from late steering-command provision; the 50 ms bound is marked tbc in the source.
